field_evidence.knife_data_quality_note: From September 2025, Knife Crime data aligns with the Home Office NDQIS process and is refreshed on/by the 18th of the month.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official Metropolitan Police Service MPS Monthly Crime Dashboard Data. The datasets include Borough and Safer Neighbourhood Team (SNT) geography types. The current Knife Crime resource M1045_MonthlyCrimeDashboard_KnifeCrimeData.csv covers September 2022 through August 2026. From September 2025, Knife Crime data aligns with the Home Office NDQIS data-quality process. This batch binds Campden to that unused SNT-level Knife Crime resource; Campden row extraction, parcel spatial join and materialization are deferred to local OpenCode, so no Knife Crime row values or parcel progress are claimed.
